newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech SPT says calls via Germany restored.
newsitem.headline: Czech SPT says calls via Germany restored.

text.p: The Czech telephone company SPT Telecom a.s. said on Tuesday that international connections through Germany, cut early in the morning due to a cable disruption on German territory, had been restored.
In a statement SPT said that the the cable disruption, which occured at 8 a.m. (0700 GMT), had been repaired by Deutsche Telekom AG by 10:24 a.m..
Calls passing through Germany to such destinations as London, Zurich, Geneva, Seville, Tunis, Algiers, Lisbon, Montreal and Amsterdam were affected
Last Thursday a similar problem caused calls through Germany to be disrupted for several hours.
